features.label: Short height ankle coverage
features.text: The short shell stops below the calf to support forefoot sprains and toe fractures with a lower profile.

features.label: Plastic or aluminum strut options
features.text: Plastic struts give a durable contoured shell while aluminum struts give strong support in a lighter frame.

features.label: Rocker bottom sole
features.text: Contoured sole encourages a smooth heel to toe gait to reduce stress during walking.

features.label: Adjustable hard toe cover
features.text: Built in toe guard shields injured toes from bumps and debris and is easy to reposition or remove.

features.label: Removable heel clip
features.text: Detaches to accommodate Achilles tendon wedges when prescribed for post op protocols.

features.label: Breathable contoured liner
features.text: Wide footbed and breathable liner support the full foot and reduce pressure points.

features.label: Hook and loop closure
features.text: Multiple adjustable straps let you customize compression and fit for personalized comfort.

features.label: Fsa and hsa eligible
features.text: Qualifies for tax advantaged health spending accounts.

features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists.

measurement: Select your size based on US shoe size: XS (Men's under 4, Women's under 5.5), S (Men's 4.5 to 7, Women's 6 to 8), M (Men's 7.5 to 10, Women's 8.5 to 11.5), L (Men's 10.5 to 12.5, Women's 12 to 13.5), XL (Men's 13 and up, Women's 14 and up).
